rules.primary_type: Both independently classify the same single actual failure type; multiple/uncertain/disagreement stays unclassifiable. Intended question dimension is never a gold error type.
rules.human_status: New answer labels are AI MAX reference reviews pending explicit human confirmation; historical approvals do not certify these new answers.

baseline.execution: offline replay on the same new Astra MAX saved answers; no model call

provenance.reference_review_model_provenance: Independent AI agent declarations retained; not OpenAI API transport receipts and not independently authenticated human review.
